keyword: when will fortnite servers be back up
claims: Fortnite servers are currently down for Chapter 7, Season 2 (Showdown) maintenance.
Chapter 7, Season 2 (Showdown) maintenance began around 2:00 AM ET on March 19, 2026.
Fortnite servers are expected to be back online between 7 AM ET and 10 AM ET (4 AM - 7 AM PT) on March 19, 2026.
Early reports and the Times of India say Fortnite servers could return earlier.
